enforcementPolicy: FORCED_PER_FEEDBACK: every rule is enforced as written by the QE/SME feedback regardless of the workbook status column. Where the bound ATL105 2026-3 element reference states something different, the rule still runs and the conflict is recorded in sourceConflict for SME confirmation. A rule PASS is a feedback-conformance result, not ATL105 semantic approval or host execution.

rules.title: Every BR is linked to a segment
rules.statement: Each Business Requirement must carry a segment attribution (segment_number or ENT-SEG-* in segment_ids). A segment proposed only by an LLM pass is flagged for review; a BR with no segment fails.

rules.title: Every BR has at least one scenario
rules.statement: A BR with no linked scenario is a visible silent-coverage gap.

rules.title: Every scenario has at least one test case
rules.statement: A scenario with no linked test case is a visible silent-coverage gap.

rules.title: Every test case has physical test data
rules.statement: Each test case must declare test data and every declared leg file must exist with its metadata sidecar.

rules.title: BR segment is present in the test data
rules.statement: The segment(s) attributed to a test case's BR must be rendered in its serialized test data (e.g. a segment-102 BR chain must contain segment 102).

rules.title: Scenario adds test design beyond the BR
rules.statement: A scenario must not be a verbatim copy of its BR statement and must declare parameters or a target transaction.

rules.title: Test case has a readable name
rules.statement: Each test case in the candidate/approved catalog must carry a name or description stating its functionality/verification.

rules.title: No duplicate test cases
rules.statement: Distinct test-case IDs must not share a fingerprint or an identical test-design key (scenario, type, transaction, negative target, flow variant, requirements, request structure).

rules.title: Concrete expected response code
rules.statement: Each test case must declare a concrete expected response code; a null code makes the case a request builder, not a test.

rules.title: BR has negative coverage
rules.statement: A BR covered by test cases must have at least one negative/violation case; positive-only coverage never proves requiredness or constraints.

rules.title: TC and TD segment identity resolvable
rules.statement: Every segment composed in the test case must resolve to the same segment number in the test data. A display rename is allowed only when the producer metadata maps it to the same segment number; unresolved renames fail.
rules.sourceConflict: The QE reference request (Authorization.json) itself uses short names such as 'Standard Segment' and 'Variable Info Segment', so renames are evaluated by segment number, not by display name.

rules.title: Canonical source anchor on every leg
rules.statement: BR, TS and TC must each carry {specification, version, segment, rule}.

rules.title: BR keeps the source-row value constraint
rules.statement: A BR whose only expected behavior is presence ('is required and must be present') has dropped the fixed value, enumeration, length or format constraint.

rules.title: No PASS verdict with unresolved advisories
rules.statement: A producer verification PASS must be downgraded when the case carries UNRESOLVED_KB_GAP / CONSTRAINT_RULE_UNDEFINED / CONSTRAINT_NOT_VERIFIABLE advisories.

rules.title: Test data is not empty
rules.statement: A test-data leg must contain at least one data segment with content; an empty object cannot be COMPLETE or PASS.

rules.title: Composed segments are fully serialized
rules.statement: Every segment composed with values in the test case must be serialized, and every serialized segment must carry its fields (a segment holding only Segment Type, or with fields omitted by the composer, is incomplete).
rules.sourceConflict: Required/optional/conditional presence per transaction context is not SME-adjudicated; per feedback all fields of a serialized segment are expected.

rules.title: Approval Number by transaction context
rules.statement: In Segment 100 of a financial request, ApprovalNumber must always be present: empty for sale (0/4/6), authorization (3/5/B) and refund (7); a 6-character value for completion, void (8/C) and void of return (U).
rules.sourceConflict: Element 5 says Approval Number in a Purchase Request makes it preauthorized; empty-field presence on sale/auth/refund is a QE serialization convention pending SME confirmation.

rules.title: Segment Length present and valid
rules.statement: Every data segment must carry SegmentLength as a non-zero numeric value with the Element 84 width (4 digits for segments 103/114/115/118/120/130/131, otherwise 3).
rules.sourceConflict: The length value is checked for presence/width/non-zero only; exact calculated length needs the wire encoding.

rules.title: Segment 100 field set present
rules.statement: Segment 100 of a financial request must contain Track/Card Discretionary data, Encrypted PIN Block Data, Pump/Lane Number, Fuel Purchase Amount, Non-Fuel Amount, Tax Amount, Cash Amount, Approval Number and Local Date/Time (empty values allowed).
rules.sourceConflict: Matches the QE reference request shape; ATL105 marks several of these conditional.

rules.title: Terminal ID length 13-22
rules.statement: TerminalID must be 13 to 22 characters.
rules.sourceConflict: ATL105 2026-3 Element 102 defines Terminal Identifier as 22 bytes; the 13-22 range is QE feedback pending SME confirmation.

rules.title: Segment Type matches the segment
rules.statement: Each serialized segment's SegmentType must equal the segment number of that segment (no default 100/105).

rules.title: Test data ID differs from test case ID
rules.statement: Test data must use its own identifier (TD-nnnn or TD-TC-nnnn), not the TC-nnnn test-case identifier.

rules.title: NumSegments name and count
rules.statement: Data Section 1 must use the field name NumSegments and its value must equal the number of serialized segments.
rules.sourceConflict: ATL105 names Element 63 'Number of Segments'; NumSegments is the QE/ProvaMerchant naming convention.

rules.title: Segment 123 has Token PAN Suffix
rules.statement: When Segment 123 (NFC Payment Tokenization) is serialized it must contain TokenPANSuffix.
rules.sourceConflict: ATL105 2026-3 Element 197 says Token PAN Suffix is returned only for Visa/MasterCard/Interlink/Maestro tokenized transactions (response side).

rules.title: CAVV Revised Format is alphanumeric data
rules.statement: CAVVRevisedFormat must be an alphanumeric value of at most 20 characters and must not contain the table header word 'Position'.

rules.title: Track Data combines Account Number and discretionary data
rules.statement: Segment 100 of a financial card request must carry TrackData combining Account Number and Card Discretionary Block Data with a separator, not a separate AccountNumber field, and TrackData must not exceed 75 characters (24 + 51).
rules.sourceConflict: Keyed (non-track) entry and TransArmor token lengths differ; context-specific exceptions need SME confirmation.

rules.title: Segment 111 indicator and information fields present
rules.statement: Segment 111 must contain VariableInformationIndicator and VariableInformation fields (empty string allowed).
rules.sourceConflict: The QE reference request represents these as VarInfoTable TableID/Value entries; explicit fields are required per feedback.

rules.title: No duplicated field aliases
rules.statement: A segment must not repeat a field under a numbered alias (e.g. VariableInformationLength and VariableInformationLength2).

rules.title: Specification source set and version
rules.statement: No hard-coded 2025-3 version; the delivery must ingest the Dynamic Card Table Addendum 2014-1 and the TransArmor Processing Updates 2024-2 and bind to the current ATL105 release.
rules.sourceConflict: Which release is 'current' and the addenda applicability require source-owner confirmation.

rules.title: Financial request has 1-17 segments
rules.statement: A Financial Transaction Request must serialize at least 1 and at most 17 data segments (Section 12 data segment format table).
rules.sourceConflict: The 17-segment maximum is QE feedback; ATL105 Element 63 allows two digits.

rules.title: Prompt Code shape by message family
rules.statement: Financial requests: Prompt Code is 4 characters = 1-character Transaction Type + 3-character Card Type (e.g. 0020). Totals, download, communication and electronic mail requests: a single 3-character value.
rules.sourceConflict: ATL105 Element 78 is 4 bytes and Element 182 lists 4-digit special prompt codes (e.g. 0981 Electronic Mail); the 3-character special form is QE feedback pending SME confirmation.

rules.title: TransArmor requests carry expiration date
rules.statement: For TransArmor/token transactions the expiration date must be included with the account/track data.

rules.title: Readable review outputs
rules.statement: The delivery must provide readable BR/TS/TC views, a per-segment 8-column manual test table, per-TC test case cards with derivation path, a regenerated traceability matrix and clickable source-page links.
